scams.name: The Fake Porta Marina "Info Point" & Unlicensed Guide Pitch
scams.description: Lanyard-wearing touts between the Pompei Scavi Circumvesuviana stop and the Porta Marina gate herd tourists into private 'Info Point' / 'Pompei Service' storefronts where they are told the ticket office is sold out and that guided tours cost €100–€150 per person. A 2024 r/ancientrome 'Pompeii Scam' thread warns travelers to ignore anyone before the turnstile; TripAdvisor reviews ('TRUFFA! Info Point NON Ufficiale!') document the €150/head pitch. A September 2025 internapoli.it report documents a 44-year-old denounced by Carabinieri for esercizio abusivo della professione after leading American tourists inside the Scavi without a Regione Campania guiding license; Il Mattino and August 2024 Made in Pompei follow-ups confirm ongoing enforcement (three unlicensed guides, ~€5,000 in sanctions).
scams.avoidance: Walk past every lanyard-wearing tout on the Pompei Scavi–Porta Marina approach; the first official staff you see are the turnstile security. Book tickets on ticketone.it or at the Porta Marina / Piazza Anfiteatro / Piazza Esedra official booths. Pre-book guides through licensed operators (Context, Walks, Through Eternity) or freelance guides with a verifiable Regione Campania tesserino — photograph the tesserino before paying.
scams.location: The 200-meter approach between Pompei Scavi Circumvesuviana station and Porta Marina Superiore; Piazza Esedra forecourt

scams.name: The "Skip-the-Line" Reseller Markup
scams.description: Lookalike ticket sites (pompeitickets.com, pompei-ticket-gt, pompei-service) and third-party listings sell 'skip-the-line' Pompeii admission for €35–€55 — the real 2026 adult ticket is €22 (single-site Pompei Express) or €29 (MyPompeii Card) and the park is almost never oversold. A 2024 r/ItalyTravel thread ('Pompeii — Is this site a scam?') produced the unanimous verdict: 'Do not buy them through that site. Scam city.' TripAdvisor 'Scam tickets' and 'Una truffa terribile' reviews document the pattern; the Parco Archeologico's own communiqué declares 'zero tolleranza per bagarinaggio e rivendite fraudolente.' Il Mattino's 'Pompei, il pasticcio dei ticket' documents a variant where date-locked third-party tickets become non-refundable entry denials at the gate.
scams.avoidance: Buy only on ticketone.it (the park's official partner) or at the Porta Marina / Piazza Anfiteatro / Piazza Esedra on-site booths. On GetYourGuide or Viator, confirm the listing is a real licensed guided tour with a named guide and Regione Campania license reference — not resold entry. Screenshot the current 2026 price list (pompeiisites.org/tariffe) before any reseller purchase. If a reseller refuses date changes, buy at the gate instead — walk-up entry is usually available.
scams.location: Lookalike ticket websites; third-party GetYourGuide and Headout listings; 'Info Points' outside Porta Marina and Piazza Esedra

scams.name: The Circumvesuviana Pompei-Bound Pickpocket Gang
scams.description: Groups of three to five pickpockets work the €2.80 Circumvesuviana Napoli–Sorrento line at door-open moments, especially at Pompei Scavi, Ercolano Scavi, and Sorrento. A Napoli Today arrest documented a 22-year-old robbing a Canadian tourist on the line — tourists themselves physically blocked the thief. TripAdvisor's 'Pickpockets on the Circumvesuviana train today' documents 'a gang of 3' working the train at Pompei Scavi heading back to Naples; a separate 'Aggressive pickpockets on the train from Naples' thread documents the same crews boarding at Piazza Garibaldi. r/napoli commenters in 'Alternatives to the Circumvesuviana' confirm 'pickpockets are a thing, people stealing baggage and suitcases in broad' daylight.
scams.avoidance: Wear backpack on your front or between your feet — never on your back. Keep phone and wallet in zipped inner pockets. At peak season (summer, Easter, bridge holidays) upgrade to the Campania Express (+€15, reserved seats, no standing). Board the middle of a carriage, not the doorway. If a theft is in progress, shout 'ladri!', photograph the crew, and flag station staff at Pompei Scavi.
scams.location: Circumvesuviana Napoli–Sorrento line; Napoli Porta Nolana / Napoli Centrale / Pompei Scavi / Ercolano Scavi / Sorrento stops

scams.name: The In-Park Pickpocket & Bag-Dip at the Forum
scams.description: Pickpockets work the in-park bottlenecks — the Forum, Villa dei Misteri entrance, the Lupanare queue, the Anfiteatro grandstand — where thousands of distracted camera-up visitors concentrate. A Napoli Today arrest ('Scavi di Pompei, rubavano portafogli e cellulari ai turisti') documents two men caught by the park's own vigilanza lifting wallets and phones from three tourists inside the park. An April 2026 Metropolis report documents a ladro seriale arrested near Villa dei Misteri after 'tre colpi in sequenza.' The Villa dei Misteri path is the highest-risk zone because fewer bystanders are watching.
scams.avoidance: Wear your backpack on your front inside the park. Use the free MyPompeii app for the map so both hands stay free. Never hand your phone or camera to a stranger for a photo. Carry only a day wallet (€40–€60 cash, one card) in an inside pocket; leave passport and main cards in the hotel safe. Alert the park vigilanza on Via dell'Abbondanza or near the Forum if you see a theft.
scams.location: Inside the Parco Archeologico: the Forum, Villa dei Misteri entrance, the Anfiteatro grandstand, the Lupanare queue, crowded doorways on Via dell'Abbondanza

scams.name: The Naples–Pompeii Taxi Overcharge
scams.description: Drivers at Capodichino Airport, Napoli Centrale, Sorrento, and Stazione Marittima offer 'direct to Pompei' rides for €80–€150 — 25–50× the €2.80 Circumvesuviana fare. Naples's official Comune tariffe predeterminate top out at €28.50 intra-city, with no Naples-to-Pompei fixed fare approved. r/napoli warns 'especially near stations, port and airport, lot of people do scams…they have no license'; r/ItalyTravel's 'How not to get ripped off in a taxi (Naples)' thread has 174 upvotes behind 'Don't trust Napoli/Pompei taxi drivers.' The 'credit card reader is broken' variant is also worked on these routes — drivers force an ATM stop and either PIN-skim or drive off with your bags.
scams.avoidance: From Capodichino take the Alibus (€5, ~20 min) to Napoli Centrale, then the Circumvesuviana (€2.80, ~35 min) to Pompei Scavi — under €8 and under 75 min door-to-door. From Napoli Centrale use the Circumvesuviana platforms on the lower level; ignore 'taxi to Pompei?' offers. For taxis, use FreeNow or itTaxi apps where fare is in-app and paid digitally. Always demand a receipt with taxi license number, route, time, and total before closing the door. If 'reader is broken,' refuse the ATM detour — pay cash for the meter only and report at poliziadistato.it.
scams.location: Naples Capodichino Airport taxi rank, Napoli Centrale / Piazza Garibaldi rank, Sorrento taxi rank, Stazione Marittima cruise terminal

scams.name: The Parcheggiatore Abusivo Parking Shakedown
scams.description: Unauthorized men in yellow/orange vests wave drivers into spaces near Porta Marina, Piazza Esedra, and Piazza Anfiteatro and demand €5–€20 cash with no receipt, no printed ticket, and an implicit threat of damage. Italian law (Art. 7 Codice della Strada) classifies the parcheggiatore abusivo as an administrative offense with fines up to €2,050; Napolitoday.it and Il Mattino document repeat Carabinieri blitz operations across the Naples area including at archaeological sites. There are no privately-employed vest-wearing attendants collecting cash at the Pompeii Scavi entrances — legitimate parking is metered blue-line public spots, posted private lots with machine-printed tickets, or the free Circumvesuviana Pompei Scavi station lot.
scams.avoidance: Park in a posted private lot with a machine-printed ticket (€5–€10/day) — or in the free Circumvesuviana station lot. Refuse verbal cash demands from vest-wearers with a firm 'no, grazie.' Photograph your license plate, the car, and the spot before leaving. If threatened, call 112 — Carabinieri blitz ops target this crime. Pay only legitimate parking machines by card to create a paper trail.
scams.location: Via Villa dei Misteri and lanes around Porta Marina; Piazza Esedra forecourt; streets around Piazza Anfiteatro; SS145/A3 exit approaches

scams.name: The Via Plinio Tourist-Menu & Pesce al Etto Trap
scams.description: Restaurants on Via Plinio, Via Villa dei Misteri, and the streets around Porta Marina and Piazza Esedra apply per-person coperto of €3.50–€4.50, auto-15% 'servizio' on foreign cards, unordered pane/acqua/antipasti, and seafood pasta or whole fish priced 'al etto' (per 100g) that turns a listed €9 dish into €36–€45 at bill time. Italian law (Art. 180 TULPS) requires every restaurant to post priced menus outside the door. r/ItalyTravel and r/ancientrome threads consistently steer travelers away from the directly-outside-the-gate block toward modern Pompei's Piazza Bartolo Longo for local-priced meals.
scams.avoidance: Walk 5–10 minutes east to the Piazza Bartolo Longo area around the Santuario for locally-priced trattorias. Photograph the posted outside menu before sitting; if per-unit pricing for fish or steak is missing, leave. Ask 'mi conferma il coperto e se c'è servizio?' at seating. Refuse unrequested items with 'non l'abbiamo ordinato.' Trust Italian-language Google Maps reviews sorted by Most Recent over English reviews.
scams.location: Via Plinio, Via Villa dei Misteri, streets immediately outside Porta Marina and Piazza Esedra, restaurants around Piazza Bartolo Longo

scams.name: The Bird-Poop (Mustard-Spray) Distraction Pickpocket
scams.description: A friendly-looking couple points out a white splatter on the victim's shoulder — 'un uccello!' — and swarms with aggressive hands-on 'help' cleaning it while an accomplice lifts the bag or wallet. The substance is mustard or cream sprayed from a small tube, not bird droppings. The TripAdvisor Pompeii Forum thread 'Warning! Bird Poop Pick Pocket Scam!' documents the exact Pompei version: 'a very sweet and friendly couple walking behind us sprayed some sort of mustard compilation' onto the victim. The scam concentrates at the tight exit corridors — the Circumvesuviana exit staircase, the Porta Marina ramp, the Piazza Esedra zig-zag, the Piazza Anfiteatro 6pm closing crush.
scams.avoidance: If anyone points at a 'bird' splatter near the Scavi, do not stop walking — move to an open populated area or inside a cafe before checking. Hold your bag to your front and clamp one hand on the wallet pocket the moment a stranger offers body-contact help. Refuse physical 'help' firmly with 'no, grazie' and keep moving. Real passers-by will not insist. If you are pickpocketed, call 112 and file a denuncia at the Carabinieri Stazione di Pompei on Via Lepanto.
scams.location: Circumvesuviana exit at Pompei Scavi, staircase up to Porta Marina, exits at Piazza Anfiteatro and Piazza Esedra, closing-time chokepoints
